localFindings.description: The new zero-floor guard is nominal: minPhusdOut = 1 passes (the story's own updated tests pass 1). The other four floors (minEthOut, minPromoOut, minWbtcOut, minLP) still accept 0, so Configuration Safety is asymmetric across legs. This sits inside the owner-accepted L-15 (e64f73d629, wont-fix 2026-07-19: pool() relies solely on pooler-supplied floors) - recorded for Tier 2 so it is not re-filed as new; Leg A's venue is now a much shallower ~$34k/side V2 pair than the Balancer pool L-15 was triaged against, which Tier 2 should weigh when deciding whether the L-15 acceptance still covers Leg A.
localFindings.recommendation: Informational; if L-15's acceptance is re-examined, consider requiring non-zero floors on all legs (story-049 scoped the guard to Leg A only, so this is not a faithfulness defect).
